title: Shared Rust domain core and UniFFI bindings
summary: Deterministic validated inventory transitions with a common conformance fixture, real Python FFI tests and reproducible Swift/Kotlin/Python binding generation.

profiles: Linux x86_64, Rust 1.99.0 / UniFFI 0.32.2: 2 Cargo conformance/error tests passed.
Linux x86_64, Python 3.12.14: generated binding and real shared-library conformance/error checks passed.
Linux x86_64, UniFFI 0.32.2: Swift and Kotlin binding generation completed with the configured module/package names.
notes: Swift/Kotlin host tests, mobile ABIs, Apple cross-compilation and release linking are unexecuted; binding generation alone does not validate those runtimes.
UniFFI is MPL-2.0. Generated bindings and linked runtime artifacts retain their applicable upstream terms; the Apache-2.0 manifest covers only the original delivered glue/config/fixtures.
Generated binding/runtime trees and build products are excluded. The receiving app packages architecture-specific libraries and owns state persistence, authorization and synchronization.
